 Omaha’s fall average temperature is warmest on record so far 
 The average temperature in Omaha from Sept. 1 through now is 66.6 degrees, the warmest ever recorded for the fall season. By Bo Fogal Published : Nov. 6, 2026 at 8:34 PM CST Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google OMAHA, Neb. (WOWT) - The average temperature in Omaha from Sept. 1 through now is 66.6 degrees, the warmest ever recorded for the fall season.
 This is the last month of meteorological fall. Other years rank right behind the current season.
 Multiple days were well above average. Highs reached the 90s on nine days, the 80s on six days and the 70s on nine days.
 The average high in Omaha is about 83 degrees on Sept. 1 and about 74 degrees at the end of the month.
 October was not much different.
 Highs reached the 90s on four days in October, a new record. The previous record was three days.
 Highs reached the 80s on six days and the 70s on 11 days. The average high in Omaha is 73 degrees on Oct. 1 and 58 degrees on Halloween.
 Record highs
 Omaha broke a record high in October and tied the record as well.
 The Oct. 9 high of 88 degrees was the previous record high. The new record is 91 degrees.
 Temperatures tied the record at 91 degrees on Oct. 10 and Oct. 11.
 November started warmer than average and has cooled to closer to average, by a small margin.
 Warmer than average temperatures will continue.
